changes.title: Change requests
changes.subtitle: Proposed changes to an agreed baseline, traced, priced and decided — newest first
changes.noTarget: There is no frozen baseline to raise a change against yet. Freeze one on the Baselines page first.
changes.targetHelp: The agreed baseline is offered first. The target cannot be changed once the change is raised.
changes.field.title: Title
changes.unagreedTitle: {n} edits still carry a change that was not approved
changes.unagreedTitle_one: 1 edit still carries a change that was not approved
changes.unagreedHelp: The working set still holds these edits. The app does not undo them: undo each one before the next freeze, or approve its change.
changes.unagreedLineRetired: is {status} and retired; {number} still differs from {label}
changes.stale: Someone else changed this change request. It has been reloaded — try again.
changes.seedsHelp: Edit the requirements in the working set first, then name each one here as added, modified or removed. Saving the list clears the trace and price.
changes.seedsSaved: List saved — trace and price again
changes.analysedDone: Traced; some requirements have no effort rating yet
changes.notTraced: Not traced yet. Name what changes, then trace and price.
changes.nothingReached: The named requirements reach nothing else.
changes.skipped: Not traced, switched off for this project: {parts}
changes.unrated: {n} named requirements have no effort rating. Rate them, then trace and price again.
changes.unrated_one: 1 named requirement has no effort rating. Rate it, then trace and price again.
changes.exposureHelp: Exposure is the agreed effort of requirements this change reaches but does not name. It is shown beside the effort change, never added to it.
changes.valueNotMeasured: {label} was frozen before benefits were kept, so the change in value is not measured against it.
changes.moved: Moved since pricing: {list}. This does not block a decision.
changes.decideBody: Effort change as priced: {delta}. The decision is written to the decision log.
changes.needPriced: Only a fully priced change can be approved. Trace and price it first.
changes.coverHelp: An approved increase is covered by an approved cut on the same baseline, a budget approval for what the cut leaves, or both.
changes.noCuts: No approved, unused cut on this baseline.
changes.budgetNeeded: {n} d not covered by a cut. Record the budget approval that covers it.
changes.covered: The cut covers the whole increase.
changes.decidePermanent: Approved and rejected are final. A wrong date or text is fixed with a correction, never an edit.
changes.correctBody: This records a new decision with the same outcome, superseding {number}. {number} stays in the log, marked as corrected.
changes.carriesEdit: The working set still carries this change's edit ({list}) against {label}.
changes.retireBody: {number} leaves the register. It can be restored with Show retired. Any edits it named stay in the working set.
